status: Acquisition only; not an approved import plan
source: Edmunds JavaScript-rendered public builder and exact-style specifications
method: In-app browser normal navigation; expand each Mechanical options section; inspect rendered accessibility/DOM text; open each exact-style specifications page, verify selected style ID, expand Engine; test optional-engine checkbox selections without submitting quote forms.
normalization_notes: Engine profile keys and inventory IDs are artifact-local references, not manufacturer codes or canonical slugs.
Trim and factory body are separate. Existing 4xe suffix convention retained, including specialty trim names.
Gas/regular or premium unleaded normalized to gasoline; Gas engine context normalized to electrification none; gas/electric plug-in hybrid normalized to plug_in_hybrid. ESS is not evidence of MHEV.
No new identities for transmission, axle, tire, or package permutations (ADR-0010). Preserve exact listed descriptions without interpreting bundled equipment as dependencies.
Only 4WD is canonical drivetrain. Full-time/part-time details remain source descriptions.
Canonical fields are proposed normalized source inventory, not complete publication-ready records. Nulls are deliberate; no Engine FK, UUID or slug assigned.
Standard specification output from an earlier unverified selector-navigation attempt was discarded; all final records use exact-style pages with selected ID verified.
